targets.review_note: All game rules and deck sizes are textual. After Alice consumes her initial card, a winning trajectory ends at the Nth subsequent a transition, with b<=M and c<=K other transitions. It has (N+b+c-1)!/((N-1)!b!c!) possible orders; unconsumed B/C cards contribute 3^(M+K-b-c). Let C(t)=E_M(t)E_K(t), E_j=sum_{i=0}^j t^i/i!. Its derivative is 2C-t^M/M!*E_K-t^K/K!*E_M. Hence coefficient[i+1]=(2*coefficient[i]-boundary_terms)/(i+1), computed linearly, avoiding quadratic convolution. Multiply coefficients by the rising factorial (N)_i and 3^(M+K-i). Modular inverses exist since all indices are < modulus. Validate with exhaustive complete deck assignments, an independent double-sum formula, all three published samples and maximum dimensions.
